primary_request: Create ONE new isolated left support hand gripping the underside of a horizontal M16 ribbed handguard for the right-facing woman in reference 1. Match the glove in reference 2. The wrist enters from lower left. A solid cupped palm supports the cylinder, four naturally bent fingers curl UP and around its near surface, thumb opposes them on the far side. This is a firm rifle-foreend grasp, not an open presenting palm or a pointing finger. The reference rifle is a pose guide only: omit the entire rifle, cylinder and arm from the final asset. Keep the cylindrical grip opening genuinely transparent so the game can put the handguard through it. Include a short cuff to overlap the forearm.
style: Photorealistic high-detail 3D-render texture, matching the supplied dark tactical armor; still a flat 2D game sprite.
composition: One asset centered on a square canvas, completely visible, generous transparent margin, no text, labels, swatches, reference figures, contact sheet or extra objects.
lighting: Soft neutral studio lighting matching the references, clean alpha edges without a dark backdrop or cast ground shadow.
invariants: Keep the established Dear Human armor/glove design and believable adult human anatomy. Output real transparency, never a painted checkerboard. No whole-character redesign.
